items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks about feelings toward 'the pianist Bud Powell' as a younger musician, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal interaction or specific relationship in the provided text.

ctx.x: ... Sometimes you get paid in stamps... It's according to how they sell.

We've gotten a lot accomplished today. We talked a lot about your life work till about 1950, the 50's. Now I think it will just take one more sitting and we'll be able to go on up from there from the 50's up till now. Then there are just some general questions that are the things I was asking you, the feelings of other musicians, especially the feelings that your friends and the musicians from your era who played together felt about some of the younger musicians who came up after you, like you were talking about…
